title: Fairfax County Youth Leadership Program (FCYLP)
organization: Fairfax County Department of Management and Budget
description: A one-year leadership program for Fairfax County Public Schools juniors: monthly learning sessions, a three-week paid internship in a Fairfax County department in July, and presentations to 8th grade civics classes.
unstructured_requirements: Must be a Fairfax County Public Schools (FCPS) junior (applications are for the 2027-2028 class of Juniors)
Must be in good academic standing and have an interest in local government
One letter of recommendation required (teacher, scout leader, employment supervisor, etc.)
Monthly meetings on Wednesdays 4-6pm starting in February 2027; three-week internship in July, 40 hours per week; students arrange their own transportation
Students cannot participate in both the FCYLP and the Governor School Program

application_deadline.quote: Applications for the 2027-2028 class of Juniors are now being accepted, with applications being due no later than 11:59 p.m. on Sunday, November 8, 2026.

pay.quote: Earn $1,000 for successfully completing the 3-week internship
